correct_completion: remains uncertain until the committee votes.
full_sentence: Whether the proposal will succeed remains uncertain until the committee votes.
acceptable_variants: remains unclear until the committee votes.
is still uncertain until the committee votes.

options.text: the committee will vote on it soon.
options.why_wrong: This is a complete clause that does not supply a predicate for the nominal clause 'whether the proposal will succeed'.

options.text: remains uncertain until the committee votes.
remain uncertain until the committee votes.
options.why_wrong: The nominal clause is singular and takes a singular verb, so the plural 'remain' does not agree with it.

options.text: to remain uncertain until the committee votes.
options.why_wrong: An infinitive cannot serve as the main verb of the sentence, so the clause is incomplete.

grammar_focus: Nominal 'whether' clauses as subjects with singular verb agreement
explanation: A 'whether' clause used as the subject takes a singular verb, so the main verb must be singular to agree with it.
translation: ሀሳቡ ይሳካ እንደሆነ ኮሚቴው ድምፅ እስኪሰጥ ድረስ እርግጠኛ ያልሆነ ነገር ሆኖ ይቆያል።
